qs.q: Which iron study pattern is seen in anaemia of chronic disease?
o: Low ferritin, low serum iron, high TIBC
Low ferritin, high serum iron, high TIBC
High ferritin, high serum iron, low TIBC
High ferritin, low serum iron, low TIBC
qs.e: Inflammation sequesters iron in macrophages (high ferritin as acute phase reactant), reduces serum iron, and decreases TIBC — distinguishing it from iron deficiency.
